plugin.note: Wolves have all-zero Defence bonuses, so any melee weapon lands reliably. Fire spells exploit their 25% fire weakness (20% for Big wolves) if you are training Magic.

requirements: Combat level 20 to be assigned wolves.
No quest or Slayer level requirement.
Assigned by Turael, Spria and Mazchna.
mechanics: The level-25 Wolf has 20 Hitpoints and max hit 3 (stab); White wolves 34 HP, Big wolves 74 HP / max hit 7.
All wolf variants have +0 melee and ranged Defence bonuses, so every style is accurate.
Wolves have a 25% fire weakness (20% for Big wolves) - fire spells hit hardest for Magic training.

methods.label: Any melee weapon
methods.summary: Kill the wolves on White Wolf Mountain with any melee weapon; their +0 Defence bonuses make every hit land.
steps: Travel to White Wolf Mountain between Taverley and Catherby.
Kill the wolves and white wolves (20-34 HP); bring a little food for big/level-64 wolves.
The dense pack keeps kills fast for the task streak.
notes: Big wolves (level 73, 74 HP) hit up to 7 - eat if your Hitpoints are low.

methods.label: Fire magic
methods.summary: Cast Fire spells to exploit the 25% fire weakness while training Magic on a trivial target.
steps: Bring fire runes and an elemental staff to White Wolf Mountain.
Cast Fire spells on the wolves; the 25% fire weakness boosts your accuracy and damage.
notes: Big wolves have a 20% fire weakness rather than 25%.
